items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: Well I mean the albums with Hubert Laws were great.

ctx.x: Can you recall some of your favorite — out of that oh five to one thousand — things that you’ve played on. Is there any particular events that stand out?
Well I mean the albums with Hubert Laws were great.
Oh yes. Those were great things.
